purpose: Preflight / dry-run for a future promote from the approved_for_future_promote state. This phase ONLY simulates the promote by comparing sandbox candidates with production targets, computing hash diffs, checking backup/rollback availability, and producing a would_promote plan. It does NOT promote, does NOT write production, does NOT send Telegram, and does NOT add any timer.
env_gate_evaluated_note: this script does not read process.env; env_gate_evaluated is conservatively false; an external orchestrator must verify the env gate before any real promote

ui_indicators.primary_warning_zh: 本阶段只做 approved_for_future_promote → promote 的 preflight / dry-run，不真正 promote，不写 production，不发送 Telegram，不新增 timer。
ui_indicators.primary_warning_en: This phase only simulates a future promote from the approved_for_future_promote state. It does not actually promote, does not write production, does not send Telegram, and does not add any timer.

next_phase_proposal: C5N-6-B (proposed only, not implemented): would require an explicit future promote runner that re-verifies the env gate (CQA_DAILY_DIGEST_CONTINUOUS_PROMOTE=1) AND requires the future_promote_confirm_phrase (PROMOTE DAILY DIGEST FROM SANDBOX) BEFORE any production write or Telegram send. Even at approved_for_future_promote in this phase, the actual production write is blocked; the runner would have to re-verify the env gate + confirm phrase before any write.
